title: Kissed Briny French Cheese Mille Feuille
description: A satvik-friendly, adventurous French dish featuring pico de gallo sauce and a cheese-pull, served in a tajine-clay vessel, with a briny and savory flavor profile.

ingredients.name: glaze
ingredients.notes: made from reduced pico de gallo sauce

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut the pastry into long, thin strips, about 1 inch wide.
Layer the pastry strips in a tajine-clay vessel, brushing each strip with olive oil.
Spread a layer of chevre cheese on top of the pastry strips.
Drizzle the pico de gallo sauce over the cheese.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of pastry on top.
Brush the top layer of pastry with the glaze.
Season with fleur de sel to taste.
Bake the mille feuille in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
